used-gas-turbine-broker.html: What does a used gas turbine broker do?

A used gas turbine broker brings owners of surplus turbines and buyers together, presents the technical data, screens buyers by letter of intent and coordinates inspection, while buyer and owner sign the purchase contract directly. LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC is an independent broker for used gas turbines, steam turbines and generator sets, paid by a commission agreed in writing; purchase payments never pass through its accounts.
how-to-sell-a-used-gas-turbine.html: How do I sell a used gas turbine?

Collect the unit data (model, output, frequency, year, hours, starts, condition and documents), set your net price and offer the unit through one sales route at one price. Release serial numbers, site and full documents only to buyers who sign a letter of intent, then sign the purchase contract directly with the buyer and receive payment through escrow or an irrevocable letter of credit. LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC sells used gas turbines, steam turbines and generator sets for owners without an upfront fee.
condensing-vs-back-pressure-steam-turbin: What is the difference between a condensing and a back pressure steam turbine?

A condensing steam turbine exhausts into a condenser below atmospheric pressure and turns as much steam energy as possible into electricity. A back pressure steam turbine exhausts steam at a pressure a process can still use, so it makes less power per tonne of steam but supplies heat to the plant at the same time. Extraction turbines combine both by taking process steam out at one or more stages.
steam-turbine-faq.html: Used steam turbine FAQ: condensing or back pressure, what should a buyer know?

A condensing steam turbine exhausts into a condenser and turns as much steam as possible into power; a back pressure steam turbine exhausts steam at a pressure a process can still use, so it delivers power and process heat at the same time. A used steam turbine is further defined by its steam data (inlet pressure, inlet temperature, flow and exhaust pressure), extraction points and generator frequency. LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC lists {n_steam} used steam turbines and steam turbine generator sets on behalf of their owners.
gas-turbine-faq.html: What should I know before buying a used gas turbine?

Start with the output you need, grid frequency (50 or 60 Hz), fuel, emission limits at the site and whether the plant runs simple or combined cycle. Then check hours, starts, overhaul records and the scope of the package. Aeroderivative gas turbines suit peaking and mobile power, heavy duty gas turbines suit continuous base load.
generator-set-faq.html: What should I know before buying a used generator set?

Compare generator sets at the same rating (standby, prime or continuous), then check fuel (gas, diesel or heavy fuel oil), grid frequency and running hours since the last overhaul. Medium speed engines give more output per unit, high speed engines are compact and quick to install. coal-to-gas-repowering.html: What is coal-to-gas heat recovery repowering?

Heat recovery repowering replaces the coal boiler of an existing power plant with one or more gas turbines and a heat recovery steam generator (HRSG); the gas turbine exhaust raises steam for the plant's existing steam turbine, so the coal unit becomes a combined cycle plant. It suits plants whose steam turbine, condenser, cooling system and grid connection still have decades of life left. LKS 360-SCHREINER LLC lists gas turbines and gas turbine trains with HRSG for such projects on behalf of their owners.
